title: Outlook drag and drop fails, .msg preview without line breaks
cause: DnD goes through FileDropSupport/OutlookDropHelper (FileGroupDescriptorW + FileContents, added in df9169351) and cannot be checked without Windows + Outlook. title: Mail window drops behind main window after 'als PDF senden'
cause: SendPDFAction.execute() shows the SendEmailFrame via invokeLater while the modal ProgressIndicator (owner = main window) is still open. ProgressableAction.start() then disposes the indicator, Windows re-activates its owner (the main window), and the toFront()/requestFocus() on the frame in the same EDT event does not win. Candidate fix: show the frame only after the indicator is disposed (callback) or defer toFront with a second invokeLater
notes: Windows-only focus behaviour (does not happen on the second screen), needs a Windows machine to verify. Same handler as #1205 (mnuSendDocumentPDFActionPerformed), keep the two PRs separate.

title: Move e-mails between mailboxes
cause: Feature. The folder drop handler in EmailInboxPanel explicitly blocks cross-mailbox moves ('Nachrichten können nicht zwischen verschiedenen Postfächern verschoben werden'), and EmailService.moveMessage only works within one mailbox
maintainer: Maintainer-created customer ticket with an empty body.
notes: Needs a new server operation (fetch the raw MIME, append it to the target mailbox, delete the source) across the IMAP and Graph backends, plus a remote-interface change. There is no spec.

title: EmailUtils.buildEmlBytes drops inline metadata (no multipart/related)

maintainer: Maintainer-authored follow-up to #3512/#3513. Proposes porting buildMimeMultipart to shared code, or an equivalent implementation in EmailUtils.
notes: No visible bug today because desktop attachments are never inline. The shared builder cannot go into j-lawyer-server-common because MailAttachmentDTO lives in j-lawyer-server-api, which depends on common. Put it in server-api or mirror it in EmailUtils. EmailMimeStructureTest can serve as the test template.

title: PDF aufteilen: Teil-PDFs so gross wie das Original
cause: ArchiveFilePanel.mnuSplitPdfActionPerformed (~l.9700-9725, added 65919d462) copies pages with PDDocument.importPage() only. Link annotations (/Dest, /P) still point to pages of the source document, so every part drags the whole source page tree into the saved file. PDFBox Splitter.processAnnotations() removes these refs, which is why the scanner split (PDFSplitAction uses Splitter) is fine
maintainer: Could not reproduce, PDFs got smaller in all test setups, asked for a sample PDF (reporter then attached the BGB PDF and parts).
notes: Fits the BGB sample from gesetze-im-internet (TOC/cross links), the last part without links is small. Privacy relevant: a part sent to court/opponent contains the full original. Fix: use org.apache.pdfbox.multipdf.Splitter (start/end page) or null the link destinations and annotation /P like Splitter does, ideally in a small helper with a unit test that builds a PDF with GoTo links and asserts part size and no foreign page refs. Same loop also drops inherited /Resources (importPage warns). Not done by Stirling, the reporter's guess is wrong.

title: beAstie: Anzeigename statt Dateiname bei Anzeige und lokalem Speichern
cause: Regression from beAstie migration e43b2b0e8: BeaAttachment.toString() returns only the alias, the old wrapper Attachment.toString() returned "(alias) fileName" (verified with javap on j-lawyer-proprietary/libs/j-lawyer-bea-wrapper.jar). AttachmentListCellRenderer and BeaMessageContentUI.mnuSaveAsFile/mnuSearchSave use toString() as list text and default file name, so the extension is lost. The cancel error is an NPE in BeaMessageContentUI.mnuSearchSaveActionPerformed: FileUtils.preserveExtension(att.getName(), newName) is called before the null check when getNewFileName() returns null (introduced by 72e71b7ab).
notes: Two small topics, best as two PRs: (1) restore "(alias) name" in BeaAttachment.toString (unit-testable), (2) null check before preserveExtension on cancel (trivially reviewable). The wish to use "(alias) name" also in the bulk save of a whole message (BeaInboxPanel uses att.getName()) and the long-term unique-id idea are enhancements, keep out of scope. Related to #1743 (aliases now shown again).

title: LibreOffice paste formatting (line-height) not removable in mail edit
cause:
The custom paste handler in suneditor-template.html (handlePaste/cleanPastedHTML) deliberately keeps style attributes (attributesWhitelist all: style), so

from LibreOffice survives. SunEditor's removeFormat only strips inline formatting, not block-level styles
maintainer: Said the editor is an external library with little room for customization. The template's own custom paste handler does give room, though.
notes: Labelled duplicate (of #3255 per librelegal). A paste-as-plain-text mode (Ctrl+Shift+V flag in handlePaste) or stripping line-height/margin from pasted blocks is a small JS change in the template, but it is a product decision and can only be verified in the WebView GUI.

title: Tabellen aus Rechnern: Schriftgroesse falsch, Breite 85%
cause: StyledCalculationTable.toHtml() (clipboard path) converts the configured size with pixelFontSizeToHtmlSize() into HTML <font size=1..7> using px thresholds, so 16 becomes size 3 (12pt in LO/Word) and 12 becomes size 1 (about 7pt). The ODT/DOCX paths use the same value as pt. Table width is hardcoded width=85%
notes: Exactly matches the report (16 gives 12pt). Fix: emit CSS font-size in pt per cell (style=font-size:Npt) and width 100% (or a setting). Unit-test the generated HTML. Width change is a small product choice, maybe confirm with maintainer. Same method also never closes <b>/<i>/<u> (appends opening tags again after the value). Same reporter repeats this in a comment on #3274. Related area to #583.

title: Dateinamen beim Kopieren/Verschieben von Dokumenten beibehalten
cause: ArchiveFilePanel.copyOrMoveDocumentsToOtherCase() calls FileUtils.getNewFileName() once per selected document with applyNameTemplate=move, so every document gets a dialog and a move also applies the name template. The server copyDocumentsToCase/moveDocumentsToCase already falls back to the source name when no new name is given.
notes: Client-only change in one method: for a multi-selection ask once whether to keep the existing names, skip the per-document dialog and template, and fall back to the dialog only on a name clash (doesDocumentExist), since addDocumentImpl throws on duplicates. UI pattern (one upfront question vs a 'fuer alle' option) should be confirmed with j-dimension. Not endorsed by the maintainer yet.

cause: Feature. The IMAP listMessages in EmailService skips hasAttachments ('too expensive', near line 2056), hasAttachments(Part) only checks the top multipart level, and EmailInboxPanel.tblMails has no attachment column. MS Graph already fills hasAttachments

title: beA: Weiterleitung ohne XJustiz-Strukturdatensatz
cause: Hypothesis: BeaInboxPanel.cmdForwardActionPerformed copies every entry of msg.getAttachments() as a plain attachment, including the original xjustiz_nachricht.xml and other technical attachments, so beAstie (which generates the outgoing SDS, not our code) probably sees an existing xjustiz_nachricht.xml and skips or replaces its own SDS.
maintainer: Issue filed by j-dimension himself.
notes: SDS generation happens inside the external beAstie service, so the effect of skipping technical attachments on forward can only be verified against a live beA/beAstie. Candidate fix is small (skip isTechnicalAttachment / xjustiz_nachricht.xml in the forward loop).

title: beAstie: Papierkorb leeren funktioniert nicht
cause: BeaAccess.deleteMessage() and BeaAccess.moveMessageToTrash() are identical, both call BeaService.deleteMessage() -> DELETE /api/v1/postboxes/{safeId}/messages/{id}, which in beAstie moves to trash. For a message already in the trash BRAK answers 0119 already in trash. No permanent-delete call exists. In cmdDeleteActionPerformed the per-message Throwable is only logged, so deleting single messages in the trash silently does nothing.
notes: Needs a permanent-delete endpoint in the external beAstie service (not in this repo, unknown whether it exists) plus server and client plumbing, verification only with live beA. The silent swallowing of errors in cmdDelete could be a tiny separate fix but does not solve the issue.

title: beAstie: in der Akte gespeicherte eEB-Abgabe nicht lesbar
cause: Not located. The eEB is stored by BeaMessageContentUI.saveEebResponse() as a .bea export of the BeaMessage returned by beAstie (/eeb/confirm). If that response carries attachments without content, opening it later depends on ensureAttachmentContent() reloading from the postbox. For an outgoing eEB (zuruecklaufend) cmdEebShow only renders getEebAsHtml(null, xml), which is the #917 limitation.
notes: The screenshot content is unknown, need the error text and ideally the stored .bea file to reproduce offline. Possibly overlaps #917 (eEB response rendered without the request pair). Side finding: cmdEebShow decodes the SDS with new String(data) using the platform charset (cp1252 on Windows with Java 17).

title: beAstie: Absender / Empfaenger nur noch mit Nachname
cause: BeaService.parseMessage()/parseMessageHeader() take senderName and recipients[].name verbatim from the beAstie JSON and BeaMessageContentUI.setMessageImpl() displays them unchanged, so the short name is produced by the external beAstie service, not by j-lawyer code.
maintainer: j-dimension: update the beAstie Docker image, the missing Unser Zeichen has been fixed there for a while.
notes: Reporter asks whether only the Unser Zeichen part was fixed. Needs a check against a current beAstie image. A fix (if still needed) belongs in beAstie, not in this repo.

title: Belegdialog: erneutes Bestaetigen von Typ/Kreis verwirft Eingaben
cause: InvoiceDialog.cmdConfirmInvoiceNumberActionPerformed (update branch, currentEntry != null) only calls fillCurrentEntry() locally, then ArchiveFileService.updateInvoiceType() persists just type/pool/number and the client calls setEntry(updatedInvoice), which reloads the DB state. Unsaved status (back to Entwurf), recipient (recipientAddress reset to the stored null contact), sender, texts and unsaved position edits are lost.
notes: Fix: persist the dialog state before the type change (call save() instead of fillCurrentEntry() in the update branch, it already writes positions and header) or re-apply the unsaved fields to updatedInvoice before setEntry. Only the first confirmation works because recipient and status can only be set after the invoice exists. Same reporter and same method as #2169 (the 'wie bisher' reference), keep as separate PR and do this one first.

title: beAstie: Fehlermeldung beim Verschieben in den Papierkorb
cause: BeaInboxPanel.drop() always calls BeaAccess.moveMessageToFolder() (PUT .../move), also when the target BeaFolder has type TRASH, BRAK rejects a move into the trash and only accepts delete. Fix: if BeaFolder.TYPE_TRASH equals target.getType() call bea.moveMessageToTrash(source.getSafeId(), m) instead.
maintainer: j-dimension: the BRAK API distinguishes move-to-folder from delete (move to trash), the UI must handle it separately, he wanted to look at it.
notes: Cause confirmed by the maintainer and the fix reuses the working moveMessageToTrash path, but j-dimension said he wanted to look at it himself. Ask him before sending a PR. Restoring out of the trash via drag and drop is a separate question.

Reopened chats (AiChatTranscript.toEntries) already show tools before the answer, so only the live view is wrong. j-dimension is actively reworking this panel this week, so wait or coordinate to avoid a conflict.

notes: Behaviour is LibreOffice GUI interaction, not testable headless. Real fix would be a different embedding (page style background fill for the first page or header image), which is a design decision on the graphics letterhead feature (2e314826d, #1552). The table width/font part in the comments is #3410.

title: Text einer Notiz in Dokument uebernehmen (wie Sprachmemo)
cause: The note viewer HtmlPanel (created in DocumentViewerFactory for .html) has no 'neues Dokument' action and gets no DocumentPreviewSaveCallback, unlike SoundplayerPanel.cmdNewDocumentActionPerformed(), which passes the transcript as ingoText to EditArchiveFileDetailsPanel.newDocumentDialog() for {{INGO_TEXT}}.
maintainer: Issue written by j-dimension: transfer note text without the header into documents, like the voice memo function.
notes: Behaviour defined by analogy with the existing voice memo button. Header = the table + <hr/> that AddNoteFrame prepends, so strip up to the first <hr> and convert HTML to plain text with paragraph breaks (Jsoup), which is a unit-testable helper. LibreOfficeAccess already handles multi-paragraph INGO_TEXT. Needs the .form update. iradraconis' context-menu/Ingo idea overlaps #2934 and should stay out of scope.

title: Reply with 'normal (div)' template shows paragraph spacing
cause:
In the reply/forward branch of cmbTemplatesActionPerformed the template was prepended to a Jsoup document and serialized with doc.html() using Jsoup's default pretty printing. SunEditor turned the newlines/indentation between the template's
blocks into empty

paragraphs (htmlCompress keeps one space, which gets wrapped in defaultTag p), so it looked like 'Absatz' spacing
notes:
0958c866a (2026-06-09, 'no pretty printing because it adds unwanted empty paragraphs') sets prettyPrint(false) in exactly these reply branches and in the EmailUtils reply quoting. Not in a release tag yet (latest tag 3.5.0.16 predates it). The remaining one-line

gap before the signature is #3402.

title: Dokument aus Vorlage: Umbenennen und Beteiligtenrolle ueberschreiben sich
cause: Any change in the parties table fires PartiesPanel listener -> AddDocumentFromTemplateDialog.selectedPartiesUpdated() -> templateSelection(), which always regenerates the name from the name template and calls txtFileName.setText(docName), discarding a name the user typed
notes: Fix: remember that the user edited txtFileName (DocumentListener flag, reset on template change) and skip the name regeneration on party changes. The other direction (renaming clears the role) could not be found in code, txtFileName has only an Enter key listener, so that part needs clarification. Same pattern may exist in AddAddressDocumentFromTemplateDialog.

title: Aktenvorschlag anhand Aktenzeichen auch bei eEB-Abgabe
cause: BeaMessageContentUI.saveEebResponse() builds the SearchAndAssignDialog context from msgContainer reference fields plus response.getSubject()/getBody() of the eEB message returned by beAstie, not the subject/body of the incoming message, so a file number that is only in the original subject is never matched (the inbox save path in BeaInboxPanel uses m.getSubject()+m.getBody()).
notes: One-line fix: add msgContainer.getSubject()/getBody() to the context (could be extracted to a small static helper for a unit test). Caveats: SearchAndAssignDialog only matches against the 150 last-changed cases and lowercases the context but not getFileNumber(), so file numbers with capital letters never match (separate small bug affecting all callers). Only applies when the eEB is given from the inbox, from inside a case no dialog is shown.

cause: Units vs. factor-in-text are decided inside the RVG Groovy plugin (rvg_ui.groovy in the separate j-lawyer-calculations repository, loaded at runtime via CalculationPlugin.getUi). The client only displays the InvoicePosition units it receives.
notes: Not fixable in this repo, belongs to j-lawyer-calculations (see openspec/specs/calculation-plugins). title: Etikett ueber Desktop direkt entfernen koennen
cause: Desktop tagged entries (TaggedEntryPanelTransparent) only open the case on click, there is no context menu or action to remove a tag.
maintainer: Issue by j-dimension with empty body.
notes: UI undecided: an entry can show several matching tags, case tags vs document tags (TaggedEntry.documentId), multi-value tags, confirmation and refresh of the Tagged panel. Would be close to F once a 'context menu per shown tag' design is agreed, Swing only and not headless-testable.

title: HTML editor: content at start/end outside scrollable area
cause: suneditor-template.html sizes the editor with fixed viewport math (.se-wrapper height calc(100vh - 50px), #editor 100vh) plus body overflow hidden, which assumes one 50px toolbar row. With the 1.15 WebView zoom set in WebViewHtmlEditorPanel.initializeFX, the toolbar wraps to two or more rows in narrower windows. The editor then gets taller than the viewport: the last lines are clipped, and caret scrolling can push the top out of view with no scrollbar to bring it back. Ctrl+wheel zoom-out un-wraps the toolbar, which matches the reporter's observation
maintainer: Suspects a WebView bug caused by the 115% zoom factor and asked whether Ctrl+wheel zoom helps (it does).
notes: Fix: flex column layout (toolbar auto, wrapper flex 1 with min-height 0), or size the wrapper from the real toolbar height on resize instead of 100vh-50px. Can be pre-checked by opening the template in a browser at narrow width, but the final check needs the JavaFX client (Linux or Windows). This is a code-level hypothesis, not reproduced here.

title: REST invoice pools: smallBusiness=true bedeutet 'USt ausweisen'

title: Rundungsfehler: USt 95,665 erscheint als 95,66 statt 95,67

The 3.6 BigDecimal plugin rework (880d0ac13) removes remaining float artifacts on the plugin side. Ask the reporter to retest on 3.4 or later. Same rounding family as #2831 and #2814.

title: Kontoauszug-Import Volksbank: Verwendungszweck wird nicht gelesen
cause: The seeded CSV config 'volksbank-csv' (Flyway V3_2_0_13) maps col_purpose=8, which in the current VR-Bank export layout (Buchungstag 4, Name 6, IBAN 7, BIC 8, Buchungstext 9, Verwendungszweck 10, Betrag 11, Waehrung 12) is the BIC column. The structurally identical GRENKE config in V3_2_0_3 uses 4,6,9,7,10,11,12 while Volksbank has 4,6,9,7,8,11,12 - a typo, purpose should be 10. ImportBankStatementFrame reads nextLine[csvConfig.getColumnPurpose()] 0-based.
maintainer: Asked for an anonymised sample CSV with unchanged structure.

notes: Needs the reporter's template (or a constructed ODT with a frame anchored in the paragraph) and debugging inside simple-odf. Any workaround (e.g. handling frame paragraphs separately) touches the core ODT replacement, so medium risk.

title: Nicht-europaeische Schriftzeichen im Client kaputt (Font Inter)
cause: Main (~l.811) installs FlatInterFont and sets it as preferred font family. Inter has no CJK/Arabic/Thai glyphs, so missing glyphs show as boxes unless FlatLaf falls back to a composite font
maintainer: Confirmed Inter lacks these glyphs, not configurable for end users, workaround is editing defaultFont in FlatIntelliJLaf.properties inside the jar.
notes: Reported on macOS with FlatLaf 3.0, client now uses FlatLaf 3.5.4 whose composite font handling may already help, needs a check on macOS. A fix means a font setting or dropping Inter, which is a product decision.

title: Server does not listen on IPv6
cause: WildFly is started with -Djava.net.preferIPv4Stack=true (WildFly default and docker/wildfly/standalone.conf), so all sockets bind to 0.0.0.0 only. This is installer/runtime configuration, not j-lawyer code
notes: Installer configs are not in this repo, needs an IPv6 or dual-stack environment to verify. Client launchers also force preferIPv4Stack (related #1881)

title: Mailbox settings dialog silently discards edits when switching mailbox
cause: MailboxSetupDialog.tblMailboxesMouseClicked calls updatedUI(ms) for the newly clicked mailbox and overwrites every form field without comparing it to the mailbox currently shown. There is no dirty tracking at all
notes: Fix: remember the displayed mailbox, compare the form against it (a helper that builds a MailboxSetup from the form, also reused by cmdSaveActionPerformed) and ask save/discard before switching. Caveat: the HTML signature comes from the WebView editor, whose getText() may normalize the HTML, so compare it carefully to avoid false prompts. Split out of #1881.

title: Mail client: no IPv6, missing timeouts, client freezes
cause: Mail traffic moved from the client to the server (8f1b3ee5c, 2026-03), so the client launcher's -Djava.net.preferIPv4Stack=true no longer affects mail, and IMAP got connect/read timeouts in e9f331df2. The SMTP sessions in EmailService (testSmtpConnection and the send path near line 2468) still set no mail.smtp(s).connectiontimeout/timeout/writetimeout, and the docker WildFly config still forces preferIPv4Stack=true
maintainer: Pointed to the JavaMail IMAP/SMTP timeout properties (set them as strings). Said the IPv4 flags in the repo are test configs and the problem may be hard to reproduce.
notes: Mostly obsolete for the client (freeze, IPv4) since the server move. What remains: SMTP timeouts on the server (a tiny change that could be split out as an F item) and IPv6 for the server/docker setup (a deployment decision). Verifying needs a real mail server and an IPv6 network. #1883 was split out of this ticket.

title: Skript in Vorlage bricht bei Anfuehrungszeichen im Platzhalterwert
cause: Two spots. (1) LibreOfficeAccess.evaluateScript() substitutes bare keys with replaceAll(key, quote+value+quote) without escaping quote, backslash or dollar (Groovy GString and regex replacement). (2) setPlaceHolders (ODT and DOCX) replaces all {{...}} in the whole document before scripts run, so {{GEGNER_NAME}} inside a script string literal becomes raw text with an unescaped quote and Groovy fails
notes: Expected behaviour is clear. (1) is an S fix with a unit test on evaluateScript. Fully fixing the reporter's script needs (2) as well, e.g. evaluating script blocks before the generic placeholder pass and leaving {{KEY}} literals for that pass, which changes ordering for all script templates, hence M and med risk. Testable with a small generated ODT/DOCX (LibreOfficeODFTest, MicrosoftOfficeDocxTest exist).

title: RAM monitor counts page cache as used, constant warnings on Linux
cause: SystemMonitorTask.getPhysicalMemStatusLevel and SystemManagement.getMonitoringSnapshot use OperatingSystemMXBean.getFreePhysicalMemorySize(), which on Linux returns MemFree (sysinfo freeram) and so counts buffers/cache as used. Read MemAvailable from /proc/meminfo on Linux (fallback to the MXBean) in one shared helper
maintainer: RAM check can be disabled. An external library apparently counts buffered RAM as used (it is actually the JDK MXBean)
notes: Code unchanged since the initial commit 674bb3ade. Parsing /proc/meminfo is unit-testable. The two duplicated calculations should share the helper

title: Inline attachments without file name are not shown
cause: CommonMailUtils.getAttachmentInfo only lists inline parts (and attachment parts other than message/rfc822) when part.getFileName() != null, and getAttachmentPart looks parts up by that name. Nameless inline parts are therefore invisible in the legacy path (MailContentUI.setMessageImpl, used for .eml documents in cases) and skipped by MailboxScannerTask
maintainer: Maintainer-authored. The sample .eml is in his own case 38722.
notes: The inbox now uses the server path (EmailService.extractAttachments), which makes up names (contentId or inline_N), so only the .eml document preview and the server scanner still drop these parts. Fix: generate a stable name in getAttachmentInfo (like the existing Nachricht_<size>.eml rule) and match it in getAttachmentPart. Unit-testable with a hand-built MimeMessage. Decide whether CID images referenced by the body stay hidden.

title: Mail folder list: folder names truncated in tree
cause: Most likely the classic JTree size cache: BasicTreeUI caches each node's preferred width. EmailFolderTreeCellRenderer switches to a bold font when a folder has unread mail (and the label grows), but the code that updates counts (FolderContainer.setCachedUnread, the async refresh, markAsRead) does not call DefaultTreeModel.nodeChanged. The stale width is used and the label is clipped
maintainer: Calling nodeChanged inside the renderer would recurse. High effort, modest benefit, postponed (2021). In 2026 he could not reproduce it and left it open.
notes: The reporter still sees it in 2026, the maintainer cannot reproduce it. A fix would call nodeChanged on folder nodes after unread counts change (outside the renderer). Cosmetic and not checkable headless.

title: DOCX-Vorlagen: Platzhaltersuche sehr langsam bei Textfeldern
cause: MicrosoftOfficeAccess.getPlaceHolders() loops over every known placeholder (all party types times fields) and for each one walks all paragraphs, running XmlCursor.selectPath(CURSOR_TEXTFIELD) and xmlText() per paragraph in findInTextfield(). The tfCache only caches the parsed CTR, the XPath still runs keys x paragraphs times

notes: Perf fix in our code: collect paragraph and text box texts once, then match all keys (or one regex for {{...}}). Verifiable with a unit test comparing results before and after on a DOCX with text boxes. Maintainer wants perf work done with care, so keep it isolated to getPlaceHolders. The ODT getPlaceHolders has the same per-key pattern but no XPath.
